summary.text: Mary Frances Williams represents Georgia House District 37, which includes portions of Cobb County.

paragraphs.text: Before her election she spent 34 years as a legislative and public policy advocate, working primarily for nonprofits serving women, children and families, including as Director of Advocacy at Families First from 1984 to 1993.
She is a lifelong resident of Marietta, earned a B.A. from Earlham College, and holds a Master of Social Work from the University of Georgia.
